NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 08/18/2025
Healthy Weight program intake. Shift worker (alternating days/nights). Food recall: energy drinks on night shifts, vending machine snacks, fast food after shift.
Plan: calorie tracking at ~1800 kcal/day; pack 2 meals + 2 snacks for each shift; no energy drinks (switch to unsweetened iced coffee); stop late-night takeout after shifts, keep simple prepared meals at home.
Activity: water aerobics / lap swimming 3x/week, schedule around shifts.
Follow-up with RD in ~6 weeks.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 01/28/2026
Food log reviewed: adherent most days, ~1800–1900 kcal. No energy drinks since September. Night shift weeks still include a fast-food meal.
Adjustments: higher-protein shift snacks, keep a frozen meal at work for night shifts, smaller dinner portions on days off.
Reports he keeps up with swimming/water aerobics about 3 times a week.
Next RD visit per program schedule.

TELEPHONE ENCOUNTER — 05/07/2026
RN check-in call for Healthy Weight program. Pt continues the diet and swimming plan he started last August; logging food most days, pool 3x/week. Reports good adherence most weeks, some slips on night-shift weeks. No questions. Reminded of upcoming PCP visit.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/04/2026
S: Follow-up weight and BP. Continues the diet and exercise plan and has attended program follow-ups for the past year. Tracking food, packing shift meals, swimming 3x/week. Frustrated with the plateau — weight 121.6 kg today vs 123.2 kg in August 2025 when the plan began (-1.3%) despite reported adherence. Remembers orlistat did not work for him and caused GI problems. Asks about injectable medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 121.6 kg, BMI 39.7. BP 138/80.
